environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, billing monolith deployed as systemd service under 'billing' user. /tmp is a shared tmpfs mount. Multiple services run on the same instance including a cron-based log rotator running as root. No MAC (SELinux disabled), no container isolation, default seccomp profile (unconfined). Instance is in a private subnet but other services on the same host can access /tmp.
